title: App Onboarding: One Process, Every Time

scenes.say: Ever wonder why app onboarding always follows the same steps, no matter where it runs? Let’s break down the one idea that keeps launches smooth.

rows.b: VM or container, hardened and ready

scenes.say: Every onboarding, whether on-prem or in Azure, moves through these phases. The tools change, but the order never does.

scenes.label: Intake
scenes.sub: Owner, criticality, users, stack, sizing, ports, NFRs
scenes.say: Start with a full intake. Ask the app team about ownership, criticality, user base, tech stack, sizing, every port and dependency, and non-functional requirements.
Choose the platform based on the app’s needs. VM for full OS control, container for agility. Build and secure before anything else.

scenes.title: Flow Matrix Example
scenes.say: Map every connection in a flow matrix. It guides firewall rules, security reviews, and troubleshooting. Build it early to avoid surprises.

scenes.question: Can you skip phases if you’re in Azure?
scenes.right: No, every phase matters. Azure changes tools, not the process.
scenes.say: Don’t assume cloud platforms let you skip steps. Azure shifts the tools, but the process stays the same. Missing a phase means trouble at go-live.
